# Bini.js

A zero-config cross-platform React framework for building web, desktop, and mobile apps from a single codebase.

Bini.js is built on Vite, React, and Hono. It provides file-based routing, nested layouts, API routes, environment variables, MDX, native builds with Tauri, static generation, and deployment tooling for web, Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.

- Homepage: https://bini.js.org/
- Documentation: https://bini.js.org/docs
- Plugins: https://bini.js.org/plugins
- Showcase: https://bini.js.org/showcase
- Framework repository: https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-cli
- Official website repository: https://github.com/Binidu01/bini
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-bini-app
- Sitemap: https://bini.js.org/sitemap.xml

## Plugins

- [Plugins Overview](https://bini.js.org/plugins)

### create-bini-app

Scaffolds a zero-config Bini.js project with Vite, React, Hono, routing, native platform support, and deployment tooling.

- [Documentation](https://bini.js.org/plugins/create-bini-app)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-bini-app)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-cli)

### bini-deploy

Zero-config deployment tooling for Bini.js apps across web, desktop, and mobile.

- [Documentation](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-deploy)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bini-deploy)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-deploy)

### bini-router

File-based routing, layouts, loading and error boundaries, 404 handling, MDX pages, and Hono API route integration.

- [Documentation](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-router)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bini-router)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-router)

### bini-env

Hono-native environment variables for Node, Bun, Deno, Edge runtimes, and Workers.

- [Documentation](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-env)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bini-env)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-env)

### bini-native

Automatic Tauri integration: native project wiring, Rust plugins, manifests, and platform configuration.

- [Documentation](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-native)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bini-native)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-native)

### bini-server

Production server with ETag caching, SPA fallback, request timeouts, and graceful shutdown.

- [Documentation](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-server)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bini-server)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-server)

### bini-overlay

Development error overlay and loading indicator with HMR integration and stack traces.

- [Documentation](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-overlay)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bini-overlay)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-overlay)

### bini-ssg

Pre-renders Bini.js routes to static HTML at build time — no separate export command.

- [Documentation](https://bini.js.org/plugins/bini-ssg)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bini-ssg)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Binidu01/bini-ssg)

## Ecosystem

Official packages cover common patterns that often need extra plugins elsewhere.

Core flow:
create-bini-app scaffolds → bini-router handles routing → bini-env manages environment variables → bini-native wires native platforms → bini-server / bini-ssg handle production delivery → bini-deploy handles deployment.

Plugins are Vite-native and work across the supported Bini.js platforms.
